title: Sam Altman Says AI Won't Take Your Job… It'll Just Give You 10X More Work 😭🔥
description:
Wait so AI was supposed to give us MORE free time??
Sam Altman just exposed the plot twist nobody saw coming 😳
Tasks that used to take him WEEKS now take an HOUR —
and somehow… he's busier than EVER 💀
Here's why 👇
When you can build faster —
you build MORE.
When you can decide faster —
you make MORE decisions.
When execution time drops —
the scope of what's POSSIBLE explodes 🚨
AI isn't replacing work.
It's multiplying it 🔥
The jobs don't disappear.
They just shift to higher stakes, higher speed, higher pressure 😭
CEOs panicking about job losses are asking the WRONG question.
The real question is —
are people ready to operate at the speed AI is about to demand from them?? 👀
Because the workload isn't shrinking.
It's just getting BIGGER and FASTER 😤
Are you ready for that?? 👇
🎙️ Via NothingButTech
#SamAltman #AI #FutureOfWork #OpenAI #Productivity
